title: Madeira Airport Wind: Why Flights Get Diverted and How to Plan Around It
description: Flying to Madeira? Learn why wind diverts flights at Funchal airport, which months are worst, where planes go instead and how to plan your trip around it.
heroAlt: A plane coming in to land at Funchal airport along the coast of Madeira
keywords: best month to fly to Madeira
